H3800.def: from «03799»; properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined):--((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge).

H3801.et: from an unused root meaning to cover [compare (03802)]
H3801.def: or kuttoneth {koot-to'-neth}; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare «03802»); a shirt:--coat, garment, robe.

H3802.et: from an unused root meaning to clothe
H3802.def: from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything:--arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

H3803.def: a primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself):--beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer.

H3804.def: from «03803»; properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem: -crown.

H3805.def: feminine active participle of «03803»; the capital of a column:--chapiter.

H3806.def: a primitive root; to butt or pound:--bray.

H3807.def: a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike:--beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp.

H3808.def: or lowi {lo}; or loh (Deut. 3:11) {lo}; a primitive particle; not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles (as follows):--X before, + or else, ere, + except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), (X as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, + surely, + as truly as, + of a truth, + verily, for want, + whether, without.

H3809.def: (Aramaic) or lah (Aramaic) (Dan. 4:32) {law}; corresponding to «03808»:--or even, neither, no(-ne, -r), ((can-))not, as nothing, without.

H3810.def: or Low Dbar (2 Samuel 9:4,5) {lo deb-ar'}; or Lidbir (Joshua 13:26) {lid-beer'}; (probably rather Lodbar {lo-deb-ar'}); from «03808» and «01699»; pastureless; Lo-Debar, a place in Palestine:--Debir, Lo-debar.

H3811.def: a primitive root; to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted:--faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves).

H3812.def: from «03811»; weary; Leah, a wife of Jacob:--Leah.

H3814.et: from (003813) (or perhaps for act. participle of (3874))
H3814.def: from «03813» (or perhaps for active participle of «03874»); properly, muffled, i.e. silently:--softly.

H3815.def: from the prepositional prefix and «0410»; (belonging) to God; Lael an Israelite:--Lael.

H3816.et: from an unused root meaning to gather
H3816.def: or l owm {leh-ome'}; from an unused root meaning to gather; a community:--nation, people.

H3817.def: plural of «03816»; communities; Leum mim, an Arabian:--Leummim.

H3818.def: from «03808» and «05971» with pronominal suffix; not my people; Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea:--Lo-ammi.

H3819.def: from «03808» and «07355»; not pitied; Lo- Ruchamah, the symbol. name of a son of Hosea:--Lo-ruhamah.

H3820.def: a form of «03824»; the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything:--+ care for, comfortably, consent, × considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart((-ed)), × heed, × I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), × regard((-ed)), × themselves, × unawares, understanding, × well, willingly, wisdom.

H3822.def: plural of «03833»; lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine:--Lebaoth. See also «01034».

H3823.def: a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from «03824») to unheart, i.e. (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; also (as denominative from «03834») to make cakes:--make cakes, ravish, be wise.

H3824.def: from «03823»; the heart (as the most interior organ); used also like «03820»:--+ bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-)heart((-ed)), midst, mind, × unawares, understanding.

H3828.def: or lbonah {leb-o-naw'}; from «03836»; frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke): -(frank-)incense.

H3829.def: the same as «03828»; Lebonah, a place in Palestine:--Lebonah.

H3830.def: or lbush {leb-oosh'}; from «03847»; a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphem.) a wife:--apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.

H3832.def: a primitive root; to overthrow; intransposed, to fall:--fall.

H3833.et: from an unused root men. to roar
H3833.def: or (Ezek. 19:2) lbiyao {leb-ee-yaw'}; irreg. masculine plural lbaviym {leb-aw-eem'}; irreg. feminine plural lbaeowth {leb-aw-oth'}; from an unused root men. to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer; compare «0738»)):--(great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young (lion).

H3834.et: from (03823) in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding) TWOT - (1071)c
H3834.def: or rather lbibah {leb-ee-baw'}; from «03823» in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding); a cake (either as fried or turned):--cake.

H3835.def: a primitive root; to be (or become) white; also (as denominative from «03843») to make bricks:--make brick, be (made, make) white(-r).

H3837.def: the same as «03836»; Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert:--Laban.

H3838.def: or Lbanah {leb-aw-naw'}; the same as «03842»; Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim:--Lebana, Lebanah.

H3839.def: from «03835»; some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax:--poplar.

H3840.def: from «03835»; properly, whiteness, i.e. (by implication) transparency:--paved.

H3841.def: the same as «03839»; Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine:--Libnah.

H3842.def: from «03835»; properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon:--moon. See also «03838».

H3843.def: from «03835»; a brick (from the whiteness of the clay):--(altar of) brick, tile.

H3844.def: from «03825»; (the) white mountain (from its snow); Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine:--Lebanon.

H3846.def: patronymically from «03845»; a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively):--Libnites.

H3847.def: or labesh {law-bashe'}; a primitive root; properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on a garment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively:--(in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

H3849.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow [like (03537)]
H3849.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like «03537»); a log or measure for liquids:--log (of oil).

H3850.et: from an unused root of uncertain signification
H3850.def: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine:--Lod.

H3851.et: from an unused root meaning to gleam
H3851.def: from an usused root meaning to gleam; a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon:--blade, bright, flame, glittering.

H3852.def: or lahebeth {lah-eh'-beth}; feminine of «03851», and meaning the same:--flame(-ming), head (of a spear).

H3853.def: plural of «03851»; flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizrain, and his descendants:--Lehabim.

H3854.et: from an unused root meaning to be eager
H3854.def: from an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application:--study.

H3855.et: from an unused root meaning to glow [compare (03851)] or else to be earnest [compare (03854)]
H3855.def: from an unused root meaning to glow (compare «03851») or else to be earnest (compare «03854»); Lahad, an Israelite:--Lahad.

H3856.def: a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication) to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish:--faint, mad.

H3857.def: a primitive root; properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze:--burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.

H3858.def: from «03857»; a blaze; also (from the idea of enwrapping) magic (as covert):--flaming, enchantment.

H3859.def: a primitive root; properly, to burn in, i.e. (figuratively) to rankle:--wound.

H3860.et: from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and (02005)
H3860.def: from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and «02005»; popularly for if; hence, therefore:--for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix).

H3861.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03860»; therefore; also except:--but, except, save, therefore, wherefore.

H3862.et: probably from an unused root meaning to gather
H3862.def: probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly:--company.

H3863.def: or lu {loo}; or luw {loo}; a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!:--if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).

H3864.et: partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst
H3864.def: or Lubbiy (Dan. 11:43) {loob-bee'}; partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural): -Lubim(-s), Libyans.

H3865.def: probably of foreign derivation; Lud, the name of two nations:--Lud, Lydia.

H3866.def: or Luwdiyiy {loo-dee-ee'}; patrial from «03865»; a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural):--Ludim. Lydians.

H3867.def: a primitive root; properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend:--abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).

H3868.def: a primitive root; to turn aside (compare «03867», «03874» and «03885»), i.e. (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse:--depart, froward, perverse(-ness).

H3869.def: probably of foreign origin; some kind of nut-tree, perhaps the almond:--hazel.

H3870.def: probably from «03869» (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine:--Luz.

H3871.def: or luach {loo'-akh}; from a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal:--board, plate, table.

H3872.def: or Luchowth (Jer. 48:5) {loo-khoth'}; from the same as «03871»; floored; Luchith, a place East of the Jordan:--Luhith.

H3873.def: active participle of «03907»; (the) enchanter; Lochesh, an Israelite:--Hallohesh, Haloshesh (includ. the article).

H3874.def: a primitive root; to wrap up:--cast, wrap.

H3876.def: the same as «03875»; Lot, Abraham's nephew:--Lot.

H3878.def: from «03867»; attached; Levi, a son of Jacob:--Levi. See also «03879», «03881».

H3880.def: from «03867»; something attached, i.e. a wreath: -ornament.

H3881.def: or Leviy {lay-vee'}; patronymically from «03878»; a Levite or descendant of Levi:--Leviite.

H3882.def: from «03867»; a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea- monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Bab.:--leviathan, mourning.

H3883.et: from an unused root meaning to fold back
H3883.def: from an unused root meaning to fold back; a spiral step:--winding stair. Compare «03924».

H3884.def: or luwley {loo lay'}; from «03863» and «03808»; if not:--except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that.

H3885.def: or liyn {leen}; a primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain):--abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

H3886.def: a primitive root; to gulp; figuratively, to be rash:--swallow down (up).

H3887.def: a primitive root; properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede:--ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.

H3889.def: from «03888»; kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine:--Laish (from the margin). Compare «03919».

H3890.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «03867»; properly, adhesion, i.e. (as preposition) with:--X thee.

H3892.et: from an unused root meaning to be new
H3892.def: from an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, i.e. unused or undried:--green, moist.

H3893.def: from the same as «03892»; freshness, i.e. vigor: -natural force.

H3894.def: or lachum {law-khoom'}; passive participle of «03898»; properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body:--while...is eating, flesh.

H3895.et: from an unused root meaning to be soft
H3895.def: from an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone:--cheek (bone), jaw (bone).

H3896.def: a form of «03895»; Lechi, a place in Palestine:--Lehi. Compare also «07437».

H3898.def: a primitive root; to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction):--devour, eat, × ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).

H3899.def: from «03898»; food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it):--((shew-))bread, × eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals. See also «01036».
